topic: What is Elucera? Turn any question into a captioned 60-second animated explainer reel
narration: No filming. No editing. Just pure understanding, on repeat. Got a question? You get a sixty second cartoon back.
description: Center phone frame (same size/position as hook, x centered y 30-75%) playing finished cartoon: inside mini sun + blue bouncing dots + red straight dots looping, big word-by-word captions white/yellow center of phone. Cyan looping progress bar at bottom of phone, timer '0:60' and Lucide Share2 + Heart icons right side. Background dark with soft cyan glow. Final beat phone content crossfades to large glowing cyan question mark, rhyming hook frame 0 for seamless loop.

beats.action: Phone snaps center with reel playing; red prohibition badge 'NO FILMING' with Lucide CameraOff slams and vanishes.
Second badge 'NO EDITING' with Lucide Scissors slams over timeline that cuts away; timeline disappears.
Words PURE UNDERSTANDING pop good green inside phone; glow brightens.
Progress bar loops 0-100% twice with repeat arrow icon; dots animation loops seamlessly.
Kinetic caption 'Got a question?' pops above phone; question bubble icon appears.
Caption '60 SECOND CARTOON BACK' pops; phone content morphs to glowing cyan question mark matching hook, holding for loop.
